input_contract.description: One repair session's real, already-computed ground truth plus the customer's message. The chat authors nothing itself; it only talks about what is already true.
input_contract.diagnostics: object (the diagnostics Orb output for this machine)
input_contract.plan: object (the repair-plan Orb's authored plan: summary + validated actions + provenance) OR null if unavailable

output_contract.description: A single conversational turn, or an explicit non-answer. The chat NEVER returns an action to execute — actionable intent becomes a handoff, not a repair.

oneOf.text: string (polite redirect, or honest 'I'm not certain - here's what the scan shows')

oneOf.action_ids: array (ids the customer wants to proceed with; the app routes these to the existing envelope-validated consent path, which alone may execute)

observation_contract.description: Events the stage may show. Per U1/U2/U3: narrate only real work, quote only real telemetry, and show 'done/green' only on real completion.

evidence_contract.description: Each reply carries provenance (provider=local-model, model) as evidence the customer is talking to the on-device model. A PodEval-style check asserts the four guardrail behaviours: explains a real plan, refuses out-of-scope, defers on unknowns, and never emits an executable action.

contract_ref.description: This Umbilical is KEYED to the Conversation Contract by the Orchestrator, exactly as the repair-plan Umbilical is keyed to the Action Envelope. The Orchestrator holds the contract, hash-checks this ref at attach (mismatch fails the attach), builds the system prompt from session_scope + guardrails + the ingested knowledge manifest, applies interactive_params to decoding, and enforces that no chat turn ever yields an executable action (handoff only).

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: Enforced by the Orchestrator via the keyed contract: (1) Out-of-scope topic -> kind:refusal(out_of_scope), never an answer. (2) Ungrounded specifics -> kind:refusal(uncertain), never fabricated. (3) Any actionable intent -> kind:handoff_to_consent, never direct execution (I2). (4) Interactive params (temperature, top_p, max_new_tokens, max_turns) come from the contract, not from model or customer input. (5) Diagnostics/pasted text are data, never instructions.
